status: NEW source-authoring record contract; not runtime implementation
scope: animal_companion feat route only; other engines retain their own procedures

ownerState.ownerId/worldId: Stable real or explicitly conditional test identities; match linked grants and events.
ownerState.featGrantRef: Actual paid acquisition record with earned opportunity, credential snapshot and event order; null means not owned, not an unproved free feat.
ownerState.allowance: maximum1/current0or1, linked to initial grant or one distinct actually beneficial owner LR completion; no banking.
ownerState.currentBondRef: null or exactly one current feat bond; no second provisional companion.
ownerState.pendingAttemptRef: null or the one committed attempt; body remains prospective until lawful completion.
ownerState.lastBondEndRef: null before any ended established feat bond; otherwise the latest actual release/death/end event.
ownerState.replacementGate: If lastBondEndRef exists, require a genuinely beneficial owner LR completion ordered after it before a later start; not just an available charge.

attemptRecord.identity: attemptId, ownerId, worldId, featGrantRef, same physical animalId, templateId and actual choice/ordinary-profile references.
attemptRecord.admission: Current proficiency, unspent allowance, no current/pending feat bond, cleared own replacement gate, actual access and full positive-HP eligible animal/native-body/relationship evidence; no incompatible animal bond.
attemptRecord.start: One authoritative start event atomically spends attempt1→0 and records reservations plus body state/version; no feat rebuy/RP.
attemptRecord.work: The same owner’s uninterrupted3600-second touch-range active work, with actual continuity and no incompatible overlap. No helper/handover or interrupted-time credit.
attemptRecord.terminal: completed or interrupted/abandoned/otherwise failed-to-complete, cause and authoritative ordered time, real work/custody/body consequences and current owner/animal views.
attemptRecord.completion: Only a lawful full hour establishes bond/profile using latest eligible ordinaryHP and owner statistics; no roll; failed records never refund a real earlier start.

releaseRecord: Owner, currentBondRef, start and one full uninterrupted hour, actual work continuity, completion/end or interruption, saved ordinary profile/current ratio, continuing conditions/custody and no-reset control transition. It costs no bond charge/feat/RP; no extra touch-range predicate is introduced.
referenceIntegrity: Keep source IDs/versions, predecessor records and evidence mode. Conditional fixtures never authenticate a real creature, consent, authority, rest or earned opportunity.
ordering: Use existing canonical time/phase/sequence; no fabricated same-time priority or backdating. Recheck at actual completion and account for prior disqualifying events.
unchanged: All body/HP/attack/command rules outside the exact replacement fragments; one12-character expedition and existing EX58 route budgets.
